sections.text: Come along for a chat and an assessment on Wednesday 28th August 2019, 9.30am
Do you want to improve your English skills, become more confident and meet some new people? Our English for speakers of other langauges (ESOL) course is starting this September.
If you want to get better at speaking, listening, reading and writing in English, come along for a chat to see if this is the right course for you.
